title: UN Report Says U.S. Climate Pollution Went Up
summary:
A new report from United Nations scientists says countries are not doing enough to cut pollution that warms the planet.

The report says the United States was the only big economy where this pollution went up a lot last year. Around the world, total pollution stayed about the same.

The report says U.S. pollution grew because people used more electricity and because of Trump administration rules that support burning coal, oil and gas. The U.S. government says it does not agree with the report.

When we burn coal, oil and gas, gases go into the air and trap heat. Earth is already about 2.7 degrees Fahrenheit warmer than in the mid-1800s.

The report says warming could stay below 3.6 degrees if pollution around the world drops by about 25% in the next ten years. Countries' current plans would cut it by only about 15%.

World leaders will meet in Turkey next month to talk about climate. The Trump administration will not go.
why_it_matters: The air and weather we all share depend on how much pollution countries release.
